sources.note: Canonical announcement and official recent-news listing identify post 6401 and displayed date 2026.09.10. API PostDate is 2026-09-10 03:50:36.14 without a timezone; publishedAt represents the displayed date at midnight using the repository convention, not a verified posting instant.

sources.title: Last Call Before Mistwood event overview and overall schedule
sources.note: Original 940x3074 image: overall Sep 9, 8:30 PM to Sep 16, 7:50 PM EDT window and 25 limited sale lines. Attendance, maintenance gifts, and buffs are event context, not purchasable offers.

sources.title: Last Call Before Mistwood flash sale rounds 1–3
sources.note: Original 940x2233 image with all 25 cards (8/9/8), prices, shown contents, and limited-stock notes. Round 1 and round 2 print exact 20:30/20:29 EDT boundaries; round 2 is labeled PREVIEW. Round 3 prints Sep 14–16 only: its 20:30 start is inferred from the preceding round and printed transition convention; its 19:50 end is inferred from the overall event end on poster 1. All times are subject to change. Source order follows paired cards left then right from top to bottom.
